# Operations Workshop Notes

## Participants

Service coordinators, two department managers, a partner liaison, and a
reporting analyst.

## Request Types

- Facilities support.
- Access requests.
- Equipment requests.
- General service questions.

Facilities and equipment requests should be approved by a department manager.
Access requests are reviewed by the access team. General questions can go
directly to a service coordinator.

The partner liaison expects partner staff to submit facilities and access
requests directly. Coordinators currently receive those requests through the
shared mailbox.

## Service Expectations

Participants asked for an initial response within two working days. The
reporting analyst requested monthly measures by department, category, response
time, and closure time.

## Rollout

Operations proposed starting with Facilities in September, adding Access in
October, and moving the remaining request types before year end.

## Historical Data

Coordinators want at least three years of closed requests available for search
because older examples help classify unusual requests.
